title: confiture lint --list-rules --format json
description: The catalogue of rules `confiture lint` can apply, and the identifiers `--select` / `--ignore` accept (#150). A report mode: it never inspects a schema and always exits 0.

code.description: Stable rule identifier, as it appears in violation output (`rule_id`).

family.description: Selector group. Usually the code prefix — `sec_001` (security) and `sec_002` (security-definer) are the exception.

severity.description: Severity the rule emits by default. sec_002 and replica_001 can be escalated by configuration.

default_on.description: Whether a plain `confiture lint` applies the rule.

legacy_flag.description: Pre-0.42.0 per-rule flag kept as an alias, or null.

requires_config.description: Configuration the rule additionally needs; selecting it is necessary, not sufficient.
